headline: A big defensive play for Kansas City
what_happened: K.Fulton caught the ball thrown by D.Jones for an interception, which is when the defense steals the ball from the offense.
why_it_matters: This is great news for the Chiefs as it stops the Colts and gives KC a much better chance to win the game. It hurts the Colts' chances of winning by 15 percentage points.
pop_culture: This interception set up a touchdown for Taylor Swift's boyfriend, Travis Kelce, on the very next drive.
